title: Volume Two: The Groove
text: Track 000. The needle drops before the music does. The sound of something about to begin that already began a long time ago. Volume Two is coming.

title: Volume Two: The Commute
text: The detective takes the same road home every day. That's not a complaint. That's a fact shaped like a prayer he doesn't know he's saying. Track 001.

title: Volume Two: The Flip
text: Somewhere you cross from Side A to Side B. Unmarked. Unannounced. You don't know when it happened. You just feel it. That's The Flip.

title: Volume Two: The Format
text: Volume One was a book. Volume Two is an album. Tracks, not scenes. Sides, not acts. Grooves, scratches, skips. The detective didn't change genres. The genre changed around him.

title: Volume Two: The Landing
text: The detective solved his own case. Walked through the door. Now he's landing inside other people's bodies. One second at a time. Foreign languages he doesn't speak. Lives he doesn't live. Except — for one second — he does.

title: Volume Two: The Hidden Track
text: After silence. No number. No title. Like those old CDs where you had to wait. Volume Two has a hidden track. You'll know it when you don't hear it coming.

title: The Detective Returns
text: Same detective. Same voice. Just different now. Not wiser. Just... less surprised. Volume Two drops when the album is ready. Not before.
